notes.title: Phasing out the Training Day
notes.content:
Dear Mechanics,

We have an important announcement regarding this free demonstration version of the game.

Rover Mechanic: Training Day, first released in 2020, has been a fantastic introduction to the world of Mars Rovers. We are incredibly grateful for the community that has grown around it and for all the valuable feedback we have received.

We are a small team and, as we continue to focus our development efforts on new projects, we have decided to retire this free prologue, but remember that [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/864680/Rover_Mechanic_Simulator/]Rover Mechanic Simulator Full Version[/url] together with [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1512110/Rover_Mechanic_Simulator__Perseverance_Rover_DLC/]Perseverance DLC[/url] are and will be still available! Moreover they are currently on sale -75% off so it's a great chance to get the main game!

Thank you for your understanding and continued support.

Sincerely,
Pyramid Games Team

notes.title: ERC Rover Mechanic Challenge – Stream announcement
notes.content:
Registration for #ERC2021 Rover Mechanic Challenge has been closed! Big thank you to everyone who took interest in the competition and to those of you who decided to sign up! 🙂

[b]Rover Mechanic Challenge will start tomorrow, on September 10 at 12 PM. [/b] At this time, all participants should be present on our Discord channel and ready to start!

[url=https://discord.gg/sv9UWeh][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34825804/78367eea501a27fcbee645139981461dd4bfc4c1.png[/img][/url]

At the same time – that is, on September 10 at 12 PM – a [b]live stream [/b]of the event will start. Anyone can watch it, even if they’re not a part of the competition. Having a Discord account is not required, either! You will be able to watch it on our YouTune channel.

We invite you all to join and have fun with us during these 3 days!

[previewyoutube=wcofSb7vO94;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]About ERC RMC:[/b]

ERC Rover Mechanic Challenge is an e-tournament, during which players compete to repair Martian rovers as quickly as possible in a special version of Rover Mechanic Simulator created in cooperation with European Rover Challenge 2021.

[b]About competition:[/b]

After closing the registration, random tournament ladder will be created, including all the registered participants. The matches will be played in the single elimination system and each one will include from 2 to 4 players – the number of players depends on the number of participants. Participants will be given a contest task – tasks will be randomly selected for the participants depending on the game starting time. Their goal is to complete the task as quickly as possible (repair the Martian rover to the condition required in a given task) in each of the 4 rounds with the lowest resource consumption possible.

The ranking list will be created on the basis of the scores obtained during the game. Depending on the results, every match will end with an elimination of one player, while the others will progress to the next round.

[b]Prizes:[/b]

The main prize: The participant occupying the first position wins the ability to remotely
control the rover on MarsYard after the end of the ERC competition for a maximum of 60
minutes via the Internet.

More information about competition and prizes can be found in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?url=https://pyramid.games/media/ERC_RMS_2021_English.pdf]OFFICIAL RULES[/url].
